mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 81 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Reddan Soccer Park. We do have an air quality alert with an index of 51, and you can expect a waning crescent moon tonight. As we move into the overnight hours, the temperature will drop to a low of 71 degrees with rain in the forecast.

Regarding city business, the Plan Commission will meet on September 8th to review the site plan for 201 South Main Street. Also, the city is moving forward with the winning student designs for the new I Voted election stickers.

We have a full calendar this week. You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, local spots are hosting plenty of trivia, including at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac, and The Bogey Factory. Plus, do not miss the Farmer's Market on Wednesday and Concerts in the Park this Thursday.

In our weekly police report, on Thursday at 2:32 a.m., officers encountered two juveniles walking on Barbara Street. The individuals were cited for underage alcohol consumption and for violating the local curfew.

The flavor of the day at Culvers is Georgia Peach. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by. If you miss out, tomorrow they will be serving Chocolate Heath Crunch, and they open their doors again in the morning.
